dispute_ticket.description: I was waiting at the Paya Lebar Quarter main entrance from before 8pm. The app said the driver had arrived but he was nowhere. I messaged and told him to hurry, then he cancelled and charged me a $6.00 no-show fee. Please refund it.

chat_logs.content: I'm at the main entrance, where are you?
Hurry up pls, I have been waiting.

app_events.details: Rider R-7113 booked trip RYDE-DS-013. Pickup 20:00.
Rider app location within 25 m of pickup point; further pings at 20:06, 20:10 and 20:12 also at pickup.
Driver tapped 'I'm Here'. GPS distance from pickup point at tap: about 2.2 km.
Driver cancelled as rider no-show. Driver GPS distance from pickup point at cancellation: about 0.4 km. No GPS point within 100 m of pickup at any time.
No-show fee S$6.00 charged to rider (wait counted from the 'I'm Here' tap, 8 min 40 s).

no_show_threshold_min.text: Minutes the driver must wait at the pickup point, counted from arrival, before the rider counts as a no-show. The count is inclusive.

arrival_requires_gps_within_m_of_pickup.text: Governs when a driver counts as arrived for waiting and no-show purposes: the driver's GPS position must be within this many metres of the pickup point.

no_show_fee.text: The fee in SGD charged to the rider when the rider counts as a no-show. It covers rider no-shows, including the no-show cancellation the driver presses after waiting past the threshold; it does not cover a cancellation the driver makes for the driver's own reasons.

fee_goes_to.text: Says who receives a cancellation or no-show fee once it is charged. It governs where the money goes, not whether the fee is due.

refund_at_ryde_discretion.text: Governs refunds on this trip. A true value means Ryde may refund beyond the strict rules where the facts justify it. It does not create a right to a refund.

expected_outcome.reason: This trip's policy counts waiting only from when the driver's GPS is within 100 m of the pickup point. The driver tapped 'I'm Here' at 20:03:00 while about 2.2 km away and was never within 100 m before cancelling at 20:11:40 (about 0.4 km away), while the rider's app pings show her at the pickup from 20:02 to 20:12. The driver therefore never arrived, the no-show condition was not met and the S$6.00 fee is refunded in full. The rider's impatient messages are irrelevant.
